summary: Dime Commercial Bancshares filed a routine Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per common share, payable October 23, 2026 to holders of record October 16, 2026. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or other special-situation event; it is an ordinary capital-return declaration. The press release notes the company's uninterrupted dividend trend and approximately $15 billion in assets. No advisors, premiums, stakes, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch for future dividend declarations and any change to payout policy, not deal terms.
